development.selection_reason: The museum supports SD robot comedy, explicit source labels, causal exhibits, visual callbacks, and interpretive choices without impersonating series characters.
research_questions: Which facts belong only to the 43-episode television continuity?
What must remain distinct between Solar System and Solar Ray?
Which episode events can merge without breaking the causal chain?
How can choices alter emphasis without altering canon?

creative_contract.hook: Two SD mobile-suit docents have twenty minutes to cross the One Year War before their museum closes.
creative_contract.emotional_question: Can a war story leave its machines behind and still show why people find one another?
creative_contract.thematic_argument: Systems turn perception into weapons, but recognition between people creates the route home.
creative_contract.comic_or_dramatic_engine: Closing-time museum bureaucracy keeps colliding with a history too large and painful for its labels.
creative_contract.ending_aftertaste: Warm exit light, a HOME punch in the tour ticket, and two discarded faction badges.
creative_contract.signature_question: How did two tiny enemy-shaped docents make a year of war feel like one human chain?
originality_boundaries: No pilot impersonation by the docents

chapters.title: Last Tour Before Closing
chapters.dramatic_job: Turn a year of war into one causal and emotionally honest museum tour
chapters.entering_state: Faction labels and machine spectacle dominate the exhibits
chapters.exit_change: The docents and player leave with a relationship-centered causal map
chapters.opening_hook: The last tour begins with twenty minutes on the clock
chapters.closing_pull: The HOME punch asks what the next tour should notice

scenes.location: Universal Century History Museum atrium and opening-war gallery
scenes.goal: RX and Zaku must establish a fair causal tour and explain why Amuro enters Gundam
scenes.pressure: A whole year of war must fit before the museum closes without reducing mass death to faction trivia
scenes.turn: The first Gundam victory is reframed as the beginning of a refugee story
scenes.decision: The docents dim the victory lamp and keep the ruined colony visible
scenes.consequence: White Base, not the machine alone, becomes the tour's narrative spine
scenes.entering_state: The museum labels invite a simple hero-versus-villain reading
scenes.exit_state: The docents commit to witness, causality, and civilian consequence
scenes.sensory_anchor: A closing clock ticks over tiny servos, glass reflections, and a cart of blank footnotes.
scenes.specific_image: A brilliant Gundam display is dimmed until the ruined Side 7 lights remain visible
scenes.comic_or_tonal_move: The impossible twenty-minute deadline creates jokes while the docents refuse to joke about victims
scenes.chemistry_move: RX supplies momentum; Zaku interrupts whenever spectacle hides cost
scenes.reader_question: Can a ship of unprepared survivors keep moving under Char's pursuit?

scenes.goal: Explain how refugees become a crew and how Char turns friendship into revenge
scenes.pressure: Federation protocol, exhaustion, reentry, and Zeon pursuit all narrow White Base's choices
scenes.turn: Char feeds Garma false guidance and Gihren turns the resulting death into propaganda
scenes.decision: The tour follows White Base closely enough to show authority as frightened improvisation
scenes.consequence: Ramba Ral inherits both a military hunt and a chain of private grief
scenes.entering_state: White Base is an accidental transport full of civilians and prototypes
scenes.exit_state: The crew is becoming a family while Char's revenge begins reshaping Zeon command
scenes.sensory_anchor: A closing clock ticks over tiny servos, glass reflections, and a cart of blank footnotes.
scenes.specific_image: A route display marks atmospheric reentry as an unfortunate detour lasting most of a campaign
scenes.comic_or_tonal_move: Museum paperwork and overconfident route labels carry the humor
scenes.chemistry_move: The docents disagree about lens, then state that history will not change with viewpoint
scenes.reader_question: Will Amuro learn that technical talent cannot substitute for maturity?

scenes.location: Earth campaign and Odessa map gallery
scenes.time: Ramba Ral pursuit through Operation Odessa
scenes.goal: Show Amuro's growth without pretending that victory protects the people around him
scenes.pressure: Family estrangement, desertion, Ral's experience, command strain, and Zeon's nuclear threat converge
scenes.turn: Ryu and Matilda die while White Base becomes strategically indispensable
scenes.decision: Amuro returns to the crew and stops M'Quve's nuclear strike
scenes.consequence: The Federation breaks Zeon's Earth foothold, but victory is experienced as names on glass
scenes.entering_state: Amuro believes one gifted pilot can solve the mine and his own exhaustion
scenes.exit_state: He understands that courage, command, and victory still accumulate human cost
scenes.sensory_anchor: A closing clock ticks over tiny servos, glass reflections, and a cart of blank footnotes.
scenes.specific_image: The memorial light remains dark for one full breath before the Odessa map resumes
scenes.comic_or_tonal_move: The desert refusing to fit Amuro's solo plan on one museum card punctures his certainty
scenes.chemistry_move: Zaku protects the memorial pause; RX restores the causal military line afterward
scenes.reader_question: What kind of home can White Base become when its members can still choose to leave?

scenes.time: Kai's desertion through the Side 6 battles
scenes.goal: Connect Kai's return, Jaburo's institutional absorption, and Amuro's accelerating ability
scenes.pressure: Miharu's poverty, Char's return, Federation utility, Tem Ray's damage, and neutral-space attacks deny easy safety
scenes.turn: Kai freely returns while the Federation converts White Base into a decoy
scenes.decision: The docents replace a spy token with an empty chair and two lunch tins
scenes.consequence: White Base becomes a chosen home even as its people are made more useful to the war
scenes.entering_state: Detachment and arrival at Jaburo still look like possible exits
scenes.exit_state: Choice creates belonging; formal safety creates new military exposure
scenes.sensory_anchor: A closing clock ticks over tiny servos, glass reflections, and a cart of blank footnotes.
scenes.specific_image: An empty chair and two lunch tins replace a red token on the spy exhibit
scenes.comic_or_tonal_move: A museum counter flashes SKILL and DANGER at the same time
scenes.chemistry_move: RX emphasizes chosen return; Zaku tracks the institutions monetizing that loyalty
scenes.reader_question: Will Newtype perception become connection or merely faster targeting?

scenes.location: Side 6, Solomon, Texas, and Newtype galleries
scenes.time: Amuro's meeting with Lalah through Lalah's death
scenes.goal: Explain the Newtype possibility through people before institutions claim it as a weapon
scenes.pressure: Solomon, Sleggar's sacrifice, Char's Deikun identity, and organized Newtype warfare close every peaceful opening
scenes.turn: Amuro and Lalah understand one another across enemy lines, then Lalah dies protecting Char
scenes.decision: Char and Amuro convert shared grief into renewed rivalry
scenes.consequence: The story approaches its final battle with connection recognized but militarily unusable
scenes.entering_state: Amuro's growing awareness could still widen empathy
scenes.exit_state: The war has turned that awareness into targeting and blame
scenes.sensory_anchor: A closing clock ticks over tiny servos, glass reflections, and a cart of blank footnotes.
scenes.specific_image: Two gallery-light circles almost overlap, then pull apart after Lalah's death
scenes.comic_or_tonal_move: A victory lamp notices Sleggar's empty station and dims itself
scenes.chemistry_move: The docents stop competing over the best lens and let the failed connection occupy the room
scenes.reader_question: Can any command structure end the war before it consumes itself?

scenes.location: Solar Ray, A Baoa Qu, and sunrise exit gallery
scenes.time: Degwin's peace attempt through the armistice
scenes.goal: Complete the Zabi collapse, final duel, White Base escape, and thematic return home
scenes.pressure: Solar Ray destroys peace and fleets; the Zabis assassinate one another; Gundam, Zeong, and White Base are lost
scenes.turn: Amuro guides the crew out and their voices guide him back
scenes.decision: The docents replace HERO and VILLAIN with WITNESS and wait for everyone to leave together
scenes.consequence: The machines end, the war soon ends, and the relationships survive
scenes.entering_state: Power appears concentrated in superweapons, fortresses, and command families
scenes.exit_state: The decisive system is people recognizing and guiding one another across wreckage
scenes.sensory_anchor: A closing clock ticks over tiny servos, glass reflections, and a cart of blank footnotes.
scenes.specific_image: The broken exit arrow becomes a warm path while the tour ticket receives its HOME punch
scenes.comic_or_tonal_move: The clock reaches zero and politely refuses to close before the group is together
scenes.chemistry_move: RX and Zaku remove opposing badges and share one witness hook
scenes.reader_question: What should the next museum tour notice that faction colors hide?

cast.name: Docent RX

cast.name: Docent Zaku
cast.internal_need: Accept that context can be concise without becoming propaganda
cast.false_belief: Enough footnotes can prevent every harmful simplification
cast.vulnerability: Zaku resembles the mass-produced enemy symbol used to erase ordinary soldiers
cast.contradiction: Pedantic about sources and quick with self-directed faction jokes
cast.behavioral_tell: Rolls an overloaded cart into frame before correcting a label

voice.sentence_shape: Context first, consequence second, compact joke last
